notes: Source: Minnesota Vikings 2026 Media Guide (IA item minnesota-vikings-2026-media-guide, 622 pages; PDF page = printed page number). Records sit in two sections: 'VIKINGS LEADERS' pp. 468-471 (ALL-TIME CAREER LEADERS p468, SINGLE SEASON LEADERS p469, SINGLE GAME LEADERS pp. 470-471; tables with printed rank numbers, 't' for ties, and extra stat columns) and 'VIKINGS INDIVIDUAL RECORDS' pp. 478-490 (top-3 style lists with Career / Season / Game sub-lists and no rank numbers). Pp. 472-477 are year-by-year team leaders and were used only as a cross-check. Every digit was checked on 200 dpi crops of the page pictures.

through_season 2025: the p472 yearly tables end with 2025 rows (Jefferson 84 receptions, 1,048 yards; J.J. McCarthy), career spans such as '2014-22, 25' (Thielen) and '2012-25' (Harrison Smith) run through 2025, Jefferson's p218 bio counts 'his first six NFL seasons', and this is the 2026 edition (IA date 2026-09-09).

List choice: where the LEADERS section has the stat (career rush_yds, rec, sacks, int, tackles; season rush_yds, rec, rec_yds, sacks, int, tackles; game rush_yds, rec, rec_yds, sacks, int, tackles) the LEADERS table was used (top 10 where printed); everything else comes from the INDIVIDUAL RECORDS lists (pass_yds all scopes, pass_td all scopes, rush_td all scopes, rec_td all scopes, career rec_yds). career/rec_yds carries two entries: the 3-row exact list (p484, Jefferson row stale and marked uncertain) and a kind=column entry with the p468 yards column.

Ranks: LEADERS tables print rank numbers (kept as printed; 't' = tie, tie=true). INDIVIDUAL RECORDS lists print none: rank = printed position with tied values sharing the lowest rank (1,2,2,4 ...), the number printed once above stacked names is repeated at the start of each row's raw. Season receptions prints the separate ranks 2 and 3 for two 122-reception seasons; they keep those ranks with tie=true.

GUIDE INCONSISTENCIES between the two sections (rows copied as printed, the better-supported variant used; support for each is cited from other pages of the same guide): (a) Justin Jefferson career: p468 prints 579 receptions, 8,480 yards, 42 TD (his p218 bio says third in receptions (579), third in receiving yards (8,480), seventh in TD receptions (42)); p484 prints 571 receptions and 8,264 yards. (b) Jefferson seasons: p469 and the p472 yearly table print 2022 = 1,809 yards and 2021 = 1,616 yards; the p484 'YARDS - SEASON' list prints 1,771 and 1,509. (c) Kirk Cousins 2022 passing: p469 prints 4,322 yards (623 att, 407 cmp, 28 TD); p482, the p472 yearly table (643, 424, 4,547, 29 TD) and the bios on pp. 65 and 168 print 4,547. (d) p469 omits Kirk Cousins 2021 (33 TD) from the season TD-pass list (p483 and the p472 yearly table show it). (e) p484 prints Randy Moss's 111-reception season as 2011 (p469 and p472: 2003). (f) p469 prints the TD column of Cris Carter 1995 as 11 in both receiving tables (p472 and p485 print 17). Not used as a value here.

Sacks: no list carries a 'since 1982' qualifier. The career and season lists include pre-1982 players and seasons (Eller 1964-78, Marshall 1961-79, Page 1967-78 and Page's 1976 season); a player bio on p397 says sacks became an official statistic in 1982, so those sacks are unofficial. Every game in the single-game sacks list is from 1983 or later. Tackles: the 'TACKLES (DEFENSE ONLY)' tables (solo + assisted) were used; the guide also prints combined (defense + special teams), solo, assisted and special-teams lists on pp. 489-490 with different totals; no list says tackles are unofficial for early years.

All 30 scope/category pairs are present (no missing entries). Aggregate lines such as '10t. Many tied w/ 18 total tackles' (p471), '3 Many times, last time by Darren Sharper' (p488) and '4.0 Many times, last by Kevin Williams' (p489) are not player rows and were not copied. Single-game rush_td and rec_td lists consist of many games tied at 3 TD, all copied in printed (date) order.

Names are rearranged to first-last ('Peterson, Adrian' -> Adrian Peterson), positional tags are absent, spellings are kept as printed (Brian Robison, Earsell Mackbee, Charley Ferguson, Jerry Reichow). Years: career spans keep the printed form, dropping the parentheses ('2014-22, '25'; '2020-' marks a player the guide still lists as active). Game rows: years holds the date as M/D/YYYY (two-digit printed years expanded: 61-99 -> 19xx, 00-25 -> 20xx) followed by the printed opponent ('@' written as 'at'); raw keeps the printed text including '@'. Opponent codes are as printed (StL, BPA, Phoe., SF).
